text: ὁ ὑπερβρέφος βάλλει τὴν λευκὴν σφαῖραν πρὸς τὴν Γλαῦκα.
objects: a bright red leather ball about the size of a grapefruit
a white leather ball about the size of a grapefruit
a large gray boulder twice the size of Hyperbrephos
positioning: Hyperbrephos throws the white ball with a gentle underhand toss
Glaux reaches out to catch the white ball while still holding the red one
Lukos remains on the ground, still dazed with fading stars around his head
The white leather ball flies through the air from Hyperbrephos to Glaux
The bright red leather ball is clutched in Glaux's other wing
The large gray boulder sits ready in the background
